items.description: Endless Blading 84 SJR UFS Aggressive Frames. The Endless SJR UFS Frame is Stephen Johnstone’s signature powerblading frame with optional Siders for UFS skates. Stephen has personally tested and proven this frame’s performance at urban street sessions, pump tracks, and skate parks. This frame is ideal for aggressive skaters who want a compact, rigid big-wheel experience that carries speed smoothly through city streets and grinds at the park. The dedicated 4×84 setup of the Endless Blading 84 SJR UFS Aggressive Frames features Endless Enhanced Flat micro-rocker that feels like the worn-in flat setup on your aggressive skates, but without feeling rockered. This goldilocks geometry is fine-tuned for control and stability, especially when performing tricks or jumps. For skaters wishing to unlock grinds and soul tricks, this frame set is available with optional Sliders that bolt onto the outside of the frame. A royalty from the sale of this product supports Stephen and his skating. These frames come with the Endless Blading 84 SJR Sliders!

items.title: Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates
items.description: Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates. Bold, fast, and built for the streets—meet the Powerslide Next 125 Deep Blue, your perfect companion for urban adventures. With its striking vibrant blue design accented by classic white highlights, this skate makes a statement. Engineered for power, comfort, and control, it’s ready to push your limits as far as you’re willing to go. The foundation of every great skate starts with the boot. With the all-new Next 2.0 shell, the Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates deliver a new level of the “Next-feeling,” including a significantly wider fit, flex cuts around the eyelets, and a better wrap. The reworked fit provides a more comfortable, confidence-inspiring ride. The toe area and ankle area are significantly wider, giving your feet more natural room and reducing pressure points—especially on longer skate sessions. To improve wrap and comfort, we also added flex cuts between the eyelets, allowing the shell to adapt better for a more secure, even closure. Slide into the next generation of comfort with the MYFIT Prime Dual Fit liner, delivering a perfectly snug, customizable fit that adapts to your foot with every stride. Combined with a dynamic closure system—featuring a Kizer Clipper top buckle, Crown ratchet buckle, and durable waxed laces—Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates lock you in for unmatched control and ankle support, whether you’re carving through traffic or mastering stair bashes. The Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates feature an Elite cast aluminum frame with a 255mm setup for three massive 125mm Spinner wheels (88A SHR) that roll like a dream over any obstacle. Engineered around the advanced TRINITY 3-point mounting system, this skate drops your center of gravity for superior balance, efficient power transfer, and unmatched agility. Paired with high-performance Wicked ABEC 9 chrome steel bearings, it’s made for pure speed and seamless glides across the urban jungle. With the Powerslide Next 2 125 Deep Blue Skates, you can chase the thrill of freedom, carve your own path, and turn the city into your playground. With every push, you’ll feel the confidence and exhilaration that comes from a skate built to keep up with your ambitions. Don’t just cruise—charge forward in Deep Blue.

items.title: Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates
items.description: Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates. Powerful, sophisticated, and made for move—introducing the Powerslide Next 80 Chocolate, a cool fusion of elegant design and top-level performance. Developed for skaters who want style and control in one, this skate rolls through the city with power, precision, and unmistakable character. Urban inline skating has never looked – or felt – so smooth. The new Next 2.0 shells on the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates offer a new look while improving fit and performance. For 2026, the Next boot range has received major updates; you spoke, and we listened, but this is more than a facelift. We kept the visual DNA of the classic Next aesthetic, but completely reworked the inside of the shell, giving more room in the toe box, instep, bridge, and ankle, plus also adding flex cuts around the eyelets. The overall result is the Next 2.0 shell with a wider fit, an improved instep, and better flex and wrap. The reworked fit of the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates provides a more comfortable, confidence-inspiring ride. The toe area and ankle area are significantly wider, giving your feet more natural room and reducing pressure points—especially on longer skate sessions. To improve wrap and comfort, we also added flex cuts between the eyelets, allowing the shell to adapt better for a more secure, even closure. Comfort starts at the core, and the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates deliver with the MYFIT Prime Dual Fit liner. This fully heat-moldable liner adapts to your foot like a second skin, offering the perfect balance of support and responsiveness. If you’re commuting long distances or hitting up intense street sessions, the Prime liner provides cushion and performance. A secure fit comes from a triple-closure system – the sturdy Kizer Supreme buckle at the top, the Crown ratchet buckle at the ankle, and grippy waxed laces work together to keep your foot locked in place. No slipping, no distractions – just pure, controlled movement with every stride. Beneath the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates boot, the new Elite FSK cast aluminum frame lays the foundation for a powerful ride. Two frame sizes adapt to different foot sizes: a shorter 243mm 4x80mm version for sizes 36/37 to 40/41, and a more stable 275mm 4x90mm version for sizes 42/43 and up. Whichever your setup, the ride feels smooth, responsive, and perfect for urban agility. The Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates roll on Powerslide Spinner SHR 80mm wheels with a durable and grippy 88A hardness, delivering excellent rebound and traction on all urban surfaces. Paired with Wicked ABEC 9 chrome steel bearings, the spin is fast, fluid, and built to last. The TRINITY 3-point mounting system holds everything together, lowering the center of gravity for improved balance, smoother push-offs, and better energy transfer. It’s your edge when weaving through crowds, hitting sharp corners, or soaking up cracks in the pavement. With a mix of brown hues and sleek silhouette, the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates are the perfect choice for skaters seeking style, power, and precision. Whether you’re carving through alleyways or cruising down boulevards, these skates deliver buttery-smooth performance in a look that stands out from the pack. Go Chocolate. Own your ride.

items.title: Powerslide HABS Syncro White Heel Brake
items.description: Powerslide HABS Syncro White Heel Brake – advanced brake technology. In cooperation with Swiss scientists, Powerslide found that heel brakes work better at steeper braking angles. You will need to lift your toes a bit higher than usual, but then you can put your full body weight onto the brake. Higher pressure on the brake pads means you can stop faster. You can adjust the height of your brake pads to suit your skating style or optimize performance as the pad wears down. The brake pad is made of long-lasting, abrasion-resistant NR/SBR material, a blend of natural and synthetic rubber. The Powerslide HABS Syncro White Heel Brake fits all skates with the Elite Syncro frame and a 270mm length/3x110mm setup.

items.title: Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks
items.description: Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks. Endless Frame Locks are the missing link for unlocking maximum performance from your 165 mount frames. Specifically designed for the lateral mounting slots on all Endless 165 frames, patent-pending Frame Locks minimize unwanted play in the frame-to-boot bolted joint while simultaneously improving mechanical coupling between the frame and boot. This part was engineered to keep 165 frames from shifting when subjected to intense or abusive skating. If you struggle to keep your frames secured in place, or have always wished for a single, perfectly centered hole for mounting your frames, Endless Blading Centered Frame Locks are your solution. Insert these parts into the front and rear mounting slots from inside the frame, replacing standard washers. The frame mounting bolt passes through the hole in the Frame Lock. Learn more about why Frame Locks are superior to standard washers.

items.title: Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates
items.description: The Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates are not just another kids’ skate — it’s the perfect start for young adventurers ready to hit the streets in style. Designed to grow with your child and built tough for daily action, this skate combines bold looks, comfort, and performance. With its classic white base and pastel accents, and trusted construction, it’s time to roll into the season with confidence. The Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates feature a solid Unibody hardboot designed specifically for kids — robust, protective, and made for those who love to push limits. Inside, a high-cut liner delivers exceptional comfort while offering enhanced lateral support, helping kids stay upright and stable. From the very first stride to their confident turns, the boot hugs the foot securely, offering just the right blend of firmness and flexibility. Thanks to a combination of standard laces, a 45-degree ratchet buckle, and a micro-adjustable top buckle, the foot is locked in safely and precisely — no more slipping, just skating! What good is a great boot without the right wheels and bearings? The Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates deliver on all fronts with a size-adapted setup that includes durable PU wheels in 64mm, 70mm, 72mm or 76mm diameters, each with a grippy 85A hardness for the perfect balance of speed and control. The ABEC 7 bearings ensure a smooth ride, while the SCS Speed Control System gives kids the confidence to control their pace — especially when they’re just starting out. Whether cruising around the park or rolling down the driveway, every element is tuned for fun, safe learning and effortless progression. Let’s be real — kids grow fast. That’s why the Playlife Khaan LTD Blue Kids Inline Skates are size-adjustable across four sizes, making it a smart investment for parents and a reliable companion for young skaters. And if the pastel look isn’t their vibe, there’s always the Pastel option for a stronger aesthetic. This skate is more than just gear — it’s the beginning of an adventure. So why wait? Let the journey begin — one smooth, confident roll at a time.

items.description: MYFIT Cushion Pro Innersoles are designed to enhance comfort, shock absorption, and foot stability in inline skates. The MYFIT Cushion Pro Innersoles feature a low arch profile; the innersoles support a natural foot position, with medium heel and midfoot support for balanced stability and efficient power transfer. Its low-stiffness construction allows adaptive flex, making it well-suited for all kinds of skating, from fitness skating and commuting to extensive urban and park sessions where impact reduction is needed. With a focus on high comfort and reliable shock function, the Cushion Pro Innersole helps reduce fatigue and refines the overall connection between foot and skate.

items.description: Powerslide Combat 290mm 110 Trinity Frames. We are thrilled to introduce the all-new Powerslide Nova 290/3×110 frame. items.title: Wicked Eugen Borklyn Zoo 608 Bearings (16 pack)
items.description: Wicked Eugen Borklyn Zoo 608 Bearings. Built for the realities of street skating, the Wicked Eugen Borklyn Zoo bearing is designed to handle rough asphalt, dusty spots, dirty roads, and constant impact. These are the conditions that challenge skate bearings every day, and the reason this bearing was developed. Inspired by the iconic German gully cover, the distinctive brown shield graphic reflects the urban environment where street skating happens. It is not just a design element but a tribute to the streets, obstacles, and surfaces that define real-world skating. The Wicked Eugen Borklyn Zoo 608 Bearings are manufactured from durable chrome steel. The bearing features a standard 608 size, an ABEC 7 precision rating, and an 8-ball construction for smooth and efficient rolling performance. The 2RZ shield configuration helps reduce dirt and dust intrusion while maintaining low rolling resistance, making it well-suited for demanding urban sessions. Combining durability, reliable speed, and long service life, the Wicked Eugen Borklyn Zoo 608 Bearings are an excellent choice for skaters who spend their time exploring the city, commuting, freeskating, or filming street lines. Built to withstand harsh environments and deliver consistent performance, this bearing is made for the streets.

items.title: Endless Blading Coburn 90 165mm Frames
items.description: Endless Blading Coburn 90 165mm Frames. The Endless Coburn Frame is the ultimate 4×90 urban skating platform developed in collaboration with Si Coburn. Over the last year, Si has personally tested and proven the versatility of this frame in every scenario imaginable–urban street sessions, marathons, group skates, roll-ins, pump tracks, hill bombs, and skate parks. For those seeking the most responsive and satisfying 4×90 experience ever imagined for 165 boots, the Endless Blading Coburn 90 165mm Frames deliver. items.title: Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels (2 PACK)
items.description: Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels – Double the Color; Double the Light; Double the Fun! LUMINOUS DUO LED wheels bring a unique bi-color lighting system that illuminates both the hub and the urethane for a spectacular skating experience. The Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels are the new generation of LED wheels featuring a unique dual-color lighting system. Unlike traditional LED wheels that illuminate in a single color, DUO technology uses two LED colors: one illuminating the wheel hub and another illuminating the urethane. This creates a striking bi-color lighting effect while skating. The system is powered by magnetic spacers that work like a dynamo, meaning no batteries are required. As the wheel spins, it generates the energy needed to power the LEDs. With a hardness of 85A, Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels offer a balanced combination of speed, grip, comfort, and durability, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor skating. Please note: These Luminous DUO LED 110mm 85A Wheels will work only with 8mm axles, so if you have a sleeve-like spacer in your wheels, you will need to add the 6mm adapters.

items.title: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames
items.description: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames. Using only the best aluminum available and the original UFS Angle design by Pieter Wijnant, Symetrics created a WZRD frame optimized for flatland skating, also known as Wizard skating. The perfect Wizard Skating Setup. The WZRD F frame is unique in every way. These Wizard Skating Frames feature a Hi-Lo wheel setup that improves reaction time while skating and offers much-needed responsiveness, thanks to a 5-wheel frame. It also uses the space inside the frame optimally by placing smaller wheels in front and larger wheels in back. The Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames have a 1-3-1 rocker combination. When the base wheels (3 middle wheels) are flat on the ground, the 80-80-84 combination in the center lets the frame turn faster. In total, the wheels used are (front to back): 80mm – 80mm – 80mm – 84mm – 84mm, with the front and rear wheels rockered. This frame also features an angled UFS. Originally designed in 2014 by Pieter Wijnant, it creates a more playful UFS frame with a flat boot design. Pieter has studied and designed the Symetrics frames to create the right angle for orthopedic comfort and performance. The UFS mount on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames uses a longer slot, so it can be perfectly centered or more toe- or heel-based. By using closed-wall construction on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Bronze Frames, with Symetrics angled cutouts at the bottom and CNC-machined from a billet block of 7075 aluminum (the highest grade in the industry), Symetrics created a unique sound and feel. Not just a copycat, based on Symetrics values. Simply designed for ultimate Wizard Skating performance.

items.title: Symetrics Quattro R 110/100 Frames
items.description: Symetrics Quattro R 110/100 Frames are designed for speed and long distance skating. Front to back, the Quattro R fits 110-100-100-110mm wheels. The smaller wheels in the middle make sure you are as close to the ground as possible, which provides stability on longer distances, while the bigger wheels on the outside give you as much speed as possible. Symetrics is proud to have created the strongest mounting known to date for any inline skate together with the Adapt Brand. Using 7075 Swiss billet aluminium for Symetrics frames and by having our outer mounting design, the Quattro frame is the most rigidly mounted frame on the market. Attention: this is not a rockered frame, but it does give a feel of higher maneuverability than a standard 4 down frame. Unlike regular frames, the Symetrics Quattro R 110/100 Frames are mounted on the outside of the frame, using 4 M6 stainless steel bolts, which, like the frame, are designed and manufactured in-house. This mounting method greatly improves power transfer and the frame’s overall strength. The frame does not flex under the boot as frames mounted with 2 or 3 bolts do. Symetrics Quattro R 110/100 Frames are fully made in the Netherlands and designed by Pieter Wijnant. This frame is the next level when it comes to skating. Every frame is CNC-machined to perfection and anodized for a perfect finish. The graphics are laser burned into the frame. Symetrics frames are made in-house and are a product of the Netherlands.

items.description: Powerslide NEXT SUV Edge 150 Off Road Skates. The Powerslide Next Edge 150 Brown is a cutting-edge off-road inline skate. items.description: Swings Swiss Ceramic S-Steel 608 Bearings. The Swings Swiss Ceramic S-Steel, engineered in Switzerland and meticulously designed in Germany, is a breakthrough in skating performance. items.title: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames
items.description: Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames. Using only the best aluminum available and the original UFS Angle design by Pieter Wijnant, Symetrics created a WZRD frame optimized for flatland skating, also known as the Wizard skating style. The perfect Wizard Skating Setup. The WZRD F frame is unique in every way. These Wizard Skating Frames feature a Hi-Lo wheel setup that improves reaction time while skating and offers much-needed responsiveness, thanks to a 5-wheel frame. It also uses the space inside the frame optimally by placing smaller wheels in front and larger wheels in back. The Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames have a 1-3-1 rocker combination. When the base wheels (3 middle wheels) are flat on the ground, the 80-80-84 combination in the center lets the frame turn faster. In total, the wheels used are (front to back): 80mm – 80mm – 80mm – 84mm – 84mm, with the front and rear wheels rockered. This frame also features an angled UFS. Originally designed in 2014 by Pieter Wijnant, it creates a more playful UFS frame with a flat boot design. Pieter has studied and designed the Symetrics frames to create the right angle for orthopedic comfort and performance. The UFS mount on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames uses a longer slot, so it can be perfectly centered or more toe- or heel-based. By using closed-wall construction on the Symetrics WZRD F 80-84 UFS Black Frames, with Symetrics angled cutouts at the bottom and CNC-machined from a billet block of 7075 aluminum (the highest grade in the industry), Symetrics created a unique sound and feel. Not just a copycat, based on Symetrics values. Simply designed for ultimate Wizard Skating performance.

items.title: Symetrics Superfast 100mm 90A Wheels (2 pack)
items.description: Symetrics Superfast 100mm 90A Wheels feature a speed profile for even stride control and fast rolling. Adapt used a 90A compound that is unmatched in both speed and grip. Pieter his obsession with finding the perfect wheel took us over a year; they tested wheels from 3 different manufacturers, several compounds, and cores. In the end, they decided to create their own mold and urethane since none of the wheel companies provided what we needed. Wanting to offer a completely blacked-out skate, Adapt always wanted a black wheel with the performance of a pure white wheel. To achieve this goal, Adapt went with the highest quality compound possible. It’s the first PURE black wheel on the current market to give both speed and grip as well as a long-lasting lifespan. Its name? The Symetrics Superfast

The higher the number, for example, ABEC 7, the less the tolerance in the bearing. Having smaller tolerances means that your bearing will spin faster, for longer.

items.title: BONES Hardcore Soft Skateboard Bushing
items.description: BONES Hardcore Soft Skateboard Bushing. When you turn a normal truck, the hanger web puts pressure on one side of each bushing (top and bottom). This squeezes that side and pushes the other side of each bushing away from the kingpin. We call this a single-action bushing because only one side of the bushing works for you at a time. The HardCore insert in the center of BONES bushings connects the two sides of each bushing together by bonding them to the HardCore insert. When the hanger web squeezes one side of a HardCore bushing, that side of the bushing reacts just like a normal bushing, but the chemical bond between the HardCore and the cushion keeps the bushing from being squeezed out the other side. It actually increases the resistance to turning because it is held in place by the HardCore insert. This means basically that BOTH sides of the BONES HardCore Bushing are resisting your turning force. That’s why BONES calls BONES Hardcore Soft Skateboard Bushing the first double-action truck bushings.

items.title: Powerslide EGO Smart 100 Trinity Frames
items.description: Powerslide EGO Smart 100 Trinity Frames are the minimalistic mockup of a Nexus frame. The simplified construction saves weight without compromising performance; it remains a stiff, responsive frame. The main benefits of the three mounting points are better power transfer for faster skating and increased stability and balance, which makes it much easier to balance and control your skates during skating in general, and especially during slides, fast stops, or jump landings. TRINITY also reduces muscle fatigue for more enjoyment on long-distance skate tours. Ego frames are crafted from 6061 aircraft aluminum, extruded, and CNC machined, including an unobtrusive laser print. TRINITY also offers the well-known X-slot mounting system, which lets you customize your boot-frame position by shifting the frame side to side and forward and back. It isn’t just the best-performing mounting system for inline skates; it’s also compatible with ALL frames across our range, so with a single Powerslide TRINITY mounting boot you can enjoy all segments of skating at any time. Simply change the frames, and you´re ready for anything – fitness, speed, urban, off-road, hockey, or even ice. Powerslide EGO Smart 100 Trinity Frames are compact, all-around frames for those who want a short, agile, lightweight, fast frame to explore the city, cruise around, work out, or play hockey.

The SPC liner is fully heat moldable – it will mold on the exterior to suit your skate as well as internally to perfectly wrap around all the contours of your feet, utilizing the CFF (Custom Fit Foam) to its fullest. Like other liners, the MYFIT SPC liner carries all the usual specs like anatomical ankle padding and a well-defined Achilles padding to give the perfect heel lock and eliminate any movement. The liner includes the MYFIT skate sole for extra support and control.

Each wheel can be rockered individually, giving you virtually limitless options. The Combat Rocker frame is designed around the famous TRINITY 3-point mounting system. With three points of contact with the boot, the TRINITY creates a channel that brings the wheels as close to the boot as possible, giving skaters a low center of gravity, excellent stability, and improved control. For the ultimate urban freeride skating experience, give the Powerslide Combat Rocker 290mm 110 Trinity Frames are the frame for you.

The tire features a Schrader valve and can be inflated to the max. 90 psi / 6.2 bar..
items.product_type: Inline Skate Wheels | Wheels For Rollerblades

items.title: Powerslide Nordic CST 150mm Air Wheel Tube
items.description: Powerslide Nordic CST 150mm Air Wheel Tube is a replacement tube for 6″ / 150mm tires used for SUV off-road skating. Made of long-lasting natural rubber material. Fits to all these Skates: XC Path, XC Trail, XC Trainer, XC Skeleton, Skiroller X-Plorer, Skike Plus, Skike V07, Skike vX Solo & Twin, Skike Fix, Skike Lift, SRB XRS01 & XRS02 & XRS03
items.product_type: Inline Skate Wheels | Wheels For Rollerblades > Skate Parts

items.title: Powerslide Roadrunner 150mm 85A PU Wheel
items.description: Powerslide Roadrunner 150mm 85A PU Wheel is a solid wheel for Powerslide Off-Road SUV and Rollerski skates using 150mm wheels. If you skate mainly on asphalt with your off-road skates and want to go faster – simply replace your 150mm tires with the Powerslide Roadrunner 150mm 85A PU Wheel and off you go! The wheel includes an extra spacer which needs to be placed on both sides of the wheel for assembly because the core is slightly narrower than the rim of the tires. The wheel features a strong and durable glass-fiber reinforced plastic (GFK) core. The polyurethane is fast and grips well in dry conditions.
items.product_type: Inline Skate Wheels | Wheels For Rollerblades

items.title: Powerslide Megacruiser Heel Brake
items.description: Powerslide Megacruiser Heel Brake is designed to work with Megacruiser and other 3-wheel frames with up to 125mm wheels. Due to a multiple mounting points on te heel brake bracket, it can be mounted on most 3x125mm frames on the market.

items.title: Powerslide HABS Heel Brake Pad
items.description: Powerslide HABS Heel Brake Pad. The replacement rubber part for the Powerslide HABS (Height Adjustable) heel brakes. Size Small is designed for S/M heel brake assembly for skates with wheels setup up to 3x110mm, while Large is for heel brakes L/XL for wheels setup up to 3x125mm. The Powerslide HABS Heel Brake Pad is fairly durable and should last a while, depending on the type of pavement and frequency of use. If you see the head of the screw that is holding it onto the heel brake bracket getting close to the brake pad surface, that is the perfect time to get an extra pad!

items.title: Powerslide Racing Rapid 335mm 4x110 195mm Frames
items.description: Powerslide Racing Rapid 335mm 4×110 195mm Frames. Powerslide’s Rapid frame is where performance, practicality, and price all combine to give you an unbeatable frame. Made from the absolute best aluminum available, the Rapid frame has been designed to be stiff, but at the same time offering a higher level of comfort over other racing frames. This more forgiving ride is especially appealing to lighter skaters, long-distance skaters, or younger skaters. This 195mm mounting frame comes in 13,2” and has a maximum wheel size of 4x110mm

items.title: Powerslide Road Hog Heel Brake
items.description: Powerslide Road Hog Heel Brake. The Powerslide Road Hog 110 Speed heel brake. Fits most frames with wheels up to 110mm including Powerslide 4×105 / 4×100 / 4×90 wheel frames. Please note: this heel brake does not work with 3×110 (243mm) frames. If you need one for that setup, please check Powerslide Urban Brake XL (908058).

items.title: Powerslide Road Hog Heel Brake Pad
items.description: Powerslide Road Hog Heel Brake Pad. This brake pad fits a lot of different Powerslide brakes such as the Road Hog brake, Megacruiser brake as well as UBS brake, SUV brake, and Urban brake in sizes S, M, and L. Usually, it should take max. 1 minute to replace your old brake. The brake pad is made of long-lasting NR SBR material, a mix of natural and artificial rubber blends. These pads are fairly durable and should last a while depending on the type of pavement and frequency of use. If you see the head of the screw that is holding it onto the heel brake bracket getting close to the brake pad surface, that is the perfect time to get an extra pad!

items.title: Powerslide Skater Finger Bell
items.description: Powerslide Skater Finger Bell. Stay out of trouble while skating on the streets! This pretty loud fingerbell will let people ahead of you know that you are coming. Stop shouting – just ring the fingerbell. Every inline skater, roller skater, skateboarder, longboarder, and scooter rider found themselves in a situation where people didn’t hear them coming and put everyone in danger. Most people are used to hearing bicycle bells and know how to react to them, so use this to your advantage. Stay Safe with the Powerslide Skater Finger Bell!

items.title: FR 8mm Spacers for 608 Bearings Set
items.description: FR 8mm Spacers for 608 Bearings Set. This is a replacement set of 8mm spacers for 608-format inline skate bearings. They can be used with most inline wheels, as well as with roller skates and skateboards, to reduce the load on bearings and increase speed. Required one per wheel.
items.product_type: Board Components > Inline Skate Bearings > Roller Skate Bearings > Skate Parts

items.title: Twincam Rustproof 608 Bearings (16 pack)
items.description: Twincam Rustproof 608 Bearings. Do you skate in all conditions? You don’t mind a little rain? Then you will love the rust-proof skate bearings designed by Twincam. These bearings are perfect for the skater who skates year-round and faces a range of weather conditions in their chosen sport. Adventure athletes such as Nordic skaters love this product for their off-road applications. The true all-weather bearings! Twincam Rustproof 608 Bearings are dust- and water-resistant, and thanks to their new special lube, they maintain good speed. With those new bearings, you will have no more fear to skate everywhere, and in any weather! These bearings are suitable for inline skates, roller skates, skateboards, kick scooters, and many other uses. They are virtually maintenance-free!

items.title: Twincam ILQ9 Pro 608 Bearings (16 pack)
items.description: Twincam ILQ9 Pro 608 Bearings are protected by a specially designed S-channel rubber shield. The SCRS presents an even more complex entry path for moisture and contamination. It is 95% effective at keeping the bearing clean. A nylon retainer on the inner face is shaped like a crown and is easy to remove and replace for servicing. These bearings are trusted by most skate manufacturers for their top-level models. These inline skate bearings are suitable for roller skates, skateboards, kick scooters, and many other uses. Twincam ILQ9 Pro 608 Bearings are high-quality and have a magnetic shield on the outer side and are open on the inner side, and are fully serviceable. Their performance is substantially above the ABEC 9 level, making these bearings an excellent choice for all skating sports, ensuring an extra-fast, smooth ride. This set of 16 bearings is enough to equip 8 wheels (2 per wheel).
items.product_type: Inline Skate Bearings > Roller Skate Bearings

items.title: Twincam ILQ9 Classic 608 Bearings (16 pack)
items.description: Twincam ILQ9 Classic 608 Bearings feature tighter tolerances than the ILQ-7 bearings and will provide thousands of miles of trouble-free use, even if you occasionally ride through dirt or rain. They go beyond ABEC rating in terms of performance, durability, design, and materials. These bearings are suitable for inline skates, roller skates, skateboards, kick scooters, and many other uses. These high-quality, high-performance bearings have a metal shield held by a clip on each side and are therefore fully serviceable. Their performance exceeds the ABEC 9 standard, making them an excellent choice for all skating sports. This set of 16 bearings is enough to equip 8 wheels (2 per wheel).
items.product_type: Inline Skate Bearings > Roller Skate Bearings

items.title: Twincam ILQ-X mr2 Speed Bearings (16 pack)
items.description: Twincam ILQ-X mr2 Speed Bearings are ultra-light, dust-protected, and fast! The mr2 bearing weighs 8,6g including the spacer compared to 11,2g of the standard 608 bearings. These bearings are ideal for inline speed skating, marathon, and long-distance skating. The perfect substitute for ceramic bearings when you do not want to break the bank.

items.title: ROTTEFELLA NNN Exercise Skate NIS Ski Bindings
items.description: ROTTEFELLA NNN Exercise Skate NIS Ski Bindings for all NNN boot systems. The Rottefella Exercise Skate binding is the more stable version of the R3 and provides long life on roller skis and nordic-skis for all riders of NNN-systems.
items.product_type: Bindings and Ski Parts > Winter Sports

items.title: Flying Eagle Skates Custom Color Kit
items.description: Flying Eagle Skates Custom Color Kit. Customize your own skates and stand out from the crowd. Pimp your ride with straps, cuffs, abrasive pads, and laces in a brilliant new array of colors. This is also the most cost-effective way to get extra spare parts! Designed for Flying Eagle F3S, F5S, and F6S Flying Eagle Skates. The side protectors do not fit the F7 model.

items.title: Twincam ILQ7 608 Plus Bearings (8 pack)
items.description: Twincam ILQ7 608 Plus Bearings (8 pack) go beyond ABEC’s rating in terms of performance, durability, design, and materials. ILQ7 are in 608 format and work perfectly for Inline Skates, Longboards, Skateboards, Scooters, and other applications. Good choice for Slalom, Freeride, and Fitness skating. These solid quality and performance bearings have a metal shield held by a clip on each side and are therefore fully serviceable. Their performance is in the range of ABEC 7 to ABEC 9 levels, so these bearings are an excellent budget choice for all skating sports.
